title: Adjunction insertion for the scalar single map
statement: Let T be a scheme, phi:A→B a homomorphism of commutative coefficient rings in the module universe, M an A-module sheaf and P a B-module sheaf on the small etale site of T, and g:E_phi(M)→P a morphism, where E_phi is ordinary sheaf scalar extension. The canonical scalarSingleMap phi T M followed by single(g) equals scalarAdjointInsertion, in the sense of def-sp-exact-degree-zero-adjoint-interface, of the ordinary adjunct of g. All single functors, scalar adjunctions and exact-single comparisons are the published canonical ones. No root lines or generator hypotheses enter this formula.

source.place: Part (3), ordinary rank-one scalar normalization: exact degree-zero scalar extension and its ordinary adjunction.

proof.text: In abstract categories, move the target single-functor image of g through the derived adjunction Hom equivalence. Expand the ordinary adjunct as its unit followed by scalar restriction of g. Naturality of the exact restriction/single comparison identifies this with the single image of that adjunct followed by the inverse exact-single comparison. This is the defining adjointInsertion. Specialize the identity to ordinary sheaf scalar extension and the canonical derived adjunction to exact scalar restriction. The Lean proof is complete.

theorem scalarSingleMap_eq_scalarInsertion
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (phi : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (M : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (P : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))
    (g : (ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars phi T).obj M ⟶ P) :
    scalarSingleMap phi T M ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map g =
    SheafExactDegreeZero.scalarAdjointInsertion T.smallEtaleTopology phi
      ((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction phi T).homEquiv _ _ g)
